page.layout: One page with one table of chronological columns, headed by a rule; the table is divided into three blocks by horizontal rules. Running head and page number at the top. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi.

page.notes: The header "Christi." is printed as "CIhriftL" with a long s; transcribed with a plain s. The last line (indiction 13, Christi 1465) sits at the bottom edge and its alignment is uncertain; the "13" is doubtful. The "Feriæ" entries use Roman-style figures printed in a different typeface, copied as the digits shown. The smudge near "1446" in the Lit. dom. column is noted but the reading is clear. The dash labels (10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 Sept.) are placed in the row where they are printed.
